svg.title: Customer Edge on GCP: two VPCs, two interfaces (SLO / SLI)
svg.desc: GCP allows one NIC per VPC, so a CE with an outside and an inside network is dual-homed across two VPCs
svg.text: Customer Edge on GCP: two VPCs, two interfaces (SLO / SLI)
GCP allows one NIC per VPC, so a CE with an outside and an inside network is dual-homed across two VPCs
control plane + RE tunnels terminate here
default internet route · no inbound listeners needed
the outside VPC only needs egress rules —
the CE dials out to the RE and the control plane
